sources.title: Scammers Use 8,400 Phishing Domains to Target Turkish Banking Customers
sources.snippet: Reported victim losses reached as high as $16,000 in individual cases. For Turkish banks, the findings highlight the need to monitor scam ads, phishing domains, cloned mobile and web interfaces, mule-account recruitment, and cryptocurrency cash-out patterns as parts of one connected threat model.
